about: wb-4nut.5: three pinned program bead maps, byte-exact. Each entry is the raw-deflate compression of the git blob named beside it (read with git cat-file at the commit below, never edited); the census inflates it, checks its length and recomputes the blob id. The maps are stored compressed so the producer's prose is never read as Pi's own text by the censuses that walk the tree. They are reader snapshots of the producer's shared store: the census models a store from them and reads it through the reader's seams; the reader never reads them.
